snippet.title: Delivery Issues - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description:
Take a look at gameplay and more from Delivery Issues in this trailer for the upcoming action-platformer game. Delivery Issues will be available on PC (Steam and itch.io), the App Store, Nintendo Switch, Xbox, and PlayStation in 2027. A demo is out now on PC, and a Kickstarter campaign is coming soon.

In Delivery Issues, you do much more than simply deliver packages. Explore levels and work out the best route to take. Avoid pitfalls, watch out for locals, and keep your wits about you as you honor the family legacy and confront a mysterious computer virus that threatens your home.
